column3: By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. define the meaning of personal security management
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. define crime ii. list the types of crime in the society iii. explain each crime iv. mention examples of various crimes mentioned
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: 1. mention the punishment for various crimes e.g. theft, rape, impersonation etc 2. describe the punishment attached to each crime

column2: Punishment for crimes e.g -production of adulterated foods (food fraud) -fake drugs
column3: By the end of the lesson pupils should be able to: 1. cite the punishment for production adulterated food 2. describe the punishment for dealing in fake drugs
By the end of the lesson pupils should be able to: 1. list the punishment for bribery and corruption 2. describe the punishment for embezzlement 3. identify the punishment for extorsion
By the end of the lesson pupils should be able to: 1. explain the punishment for false pretense, fraud and burglary
By the end of the lesson pupils should be able to: 1. identify the punishment for advance fee fraud, money laundering, terrorism and forgery
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. define economic crime ii. give examples of economic crime
